items.source: Sets up a synchronous OpenAI client.
items.translation: 配置同步的 OpenAI 客户端。

items.source: When apiKey is an empty string, the client is configured in no-auth mode: no Authorization header is sent with any request. This is useful for connecting to custom OpenAI-compatible servers that use cookie-based or other non-bearer-token authentication. To enable this mode, set spring.ai.openai.api-key= (empty value) in your application properties, or pass a NoopApiKey via AbstractOpenAiOptions.AbstractBuilder.apiKey(org.springframework.ai.model.ApiKey).
items.translation: 当 apiKey 为空字符串时，客户端将配置为无认证模式： 任何请求都不会发送 Authorization 头。这对于连接使用基于 cookie 或其他非 Bearer Token 认证的自定义 OpenAI 兼容服务器非常有用。要启用此模式，请在应用程序属性中设置 spring.ai.openai.api-key=（空值），或通过 NoopApiKey 传递 AbstractOpenAiOptions.AbstractBuilder.apiKey(org.springframework.ai.model.ApiKey)。

items.source:
Helps configure the OpenAI Java SDK, depending on the platform used. This code is
inspired by LangChain4j's
`dev.langchain4j.model.openaiofficial.InternalOpenAiOfficialHelper` class, which is
coded by the same author (Julien Dubois, from Microsoft).
items.translation: 根据所使用的平台，帮助配置 OpenAI Java SDK。此代码灵感来源于 LangChain4j 的 `dev.langchain4j.model.openaiofficial.InternalOpenAiOfficialHelper` 类，该类由同一作者（来自微软的 Julien Dubois）编写。
